title: The Loose Debt
author: Hazel Kavanagh
blurb: Jude Joubert, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
